name: Titan intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

t3.say: The manifests route through a shell company on Triton — 'Gyre Collective Logistics.' Neptune crowd. Cold people, colder money. Plutonian money, mark me.

t1.say: No names on Titan. You buying, selling, or asking? Fair warning: asking costs the most.

options.label: Pay
options.text: Here's 200 bits. The solar condensate manifests — who signs them?

options.label: Lean
options.text: The Pour Lords sent me. They're unhappy with the rate.

t2l.say: The Lords? UNHAPPY? ...Fine. No charge. But you didn't hear this from me:

t5.say: A copy of the manifest, since you've been civil. Route through the Caelus Anchorpoint at Uranus — their relays log every command burst headed to Neptune.
